question.prompt: Al gets the disease algebritis and must take one green pill and one pink pill each day for two weeks. A green pill costs \(\$1\) more than a pink pill, and Al’s pills cost a total of \(\$546\) for the two weeks. How much does one green pill cost?

solutions.explanation:
Two weeks contain \(14\) days. Since Al takes one pill of each color daily, one green pill and one pink pill together cost
\[
\frac{546}{14}=39\text{ dollars}.
\]
A green pill costs one dollar more than a pink pill. Replacing the pink pill in this pair with another green pill therefore raises the cost to \(39+1=40\) dollars. Two green pills cost \(40\) dollars, so one costs \(\boxed{\$20}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
solutions.title: Find and adjust the daily pair price
